notes.title: v9.1.01
notes.content:
[b]Add:[/b]
[list]
[*] Store Equip Menu: You can now equip items directly after item purchase
[*] Background blur shader overlay
[*] New Raining Forest background with ambient rain audio loop
[*] Dynamic lighting visuals for rainy scenes
[*] Stopwatch - Mud Trail: now features rain effects
[/list]

[b]Fix:[/b]
[list]
[*] Level Select cards not properly responding to mouse hover
[*] Menu side banners top and bottom margins
[*] Steam leaderboard issue: could fail to parse if scenes changed too quickly
[/list]

[b]Update:[/b]
[list]
[*] Night Sky background: raised moon and darker trees for improved atmosphere
[*] Level Select Menu: locked level cards now appear with a red tint
[*] Level Select Menu: improved card focus behavior for keyboard, controllers, and mouse
[*] Initial default audio levels lowered for better overall balance
[/list]

notes.title: v9.1.00
notes.content:
Fixes:
* Store category tab changing disabled when purchase panel is visible

Updates:
* Active development scene hidden
* Gas Leak game mode hidden for now
* Survival game mode hidden for now
* Max levels adjusted to match Stopwatch & Rings game modes

notes.title: v9.0.00 UI Remake
notes.content:
[h2]Update Includes:[/h2]
[olist]
[*] UI completely remade from scratch with a more controller friendly layout
[*] New vehicle part system with different stats
[*] Level tweaks to appear slightly prettier (still needs improvement)
[*] Save data fixes & slightly reduced file size
[*] Ring levels have separate coin count & rings only add to the level timer
[*] Partially working translations (some dynamic text labels are broken)
[/olist]

[h2]To Do List:[/h2]
[olist]
[*] Gas Leak & Survival levels still being developed
[*] Level complete ui panel needs better stats & item unlock icons
[*] Fix broken dynamic translation labels to display completely
[/olist]

[h2]Previous Players:[/h2]
If you played Mtn Chaos previously some settings / game data variables might be incorrect. In the Settings menu "Data" tab there's a new "Reset All Settings" button that will fix settings, for any gameplay issues go into the garage menu and click / press the active / any unlocked part in each category to reset values

[h2]Thank you for being patient with us and providing reviews as we improve Mtn Chaos together :)[/h2]

notes.title: v8.0.0 Update Release
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44331935/084347e7492dfd5e15dc201e4e04d1fc03aefc86.png[/img]

[b]Included in this update:[/b]
* Ring Race game mode now available to play
* Leaderboard categories for Stopwatch and Ring Race game modes
* Wheels no longer collide with each other to reduce instability
* Wheels have different stats so they're not just visual changes
* A number of bugs have been fixed too

From our team at TnT Gamez LLC we want to say thank you all for joining us on our Indie game dev journey. We look forward to bringing more updates and experiences in 2024

notes.title: Update to v7.0.15 dev
notes.content:
[b]Included in this update:[/b]
* Add Leaderboards menu to see all players best times
* Add stabilize feature for Cars to auto level while in the air (can be tweaked in the Settings menu)
* Add Translations for multiple languages (changed in Settings menu)
* Add Game Mode menu for different level types (Stopwatch is the only available option currently)
* Add Traffic light at the beginning of a race controls when you can start racing
* Fixed a few bugs behind the scenes

We're still using Godot 3.5.3 so left joystick is still used as a virtual mouse (when pressed toggles cursor)

notes.title: Mtn Chaos Early Release
notes.content:
[b]Mtn Chaos Early Release Available on Steam![/b]

We're excited to announce that Mtn Chaos is live on Steam! This early release allows us to gather valuable feedback while we work on upgrading to Godot 4.1.2.

By releasing the game early, we're offering the Steam community a chance to purchase it at a special, lower price during the development phase, as opposed to a higher release cost.

With this being an early release in active development, we are constantly looking for suggestions / changes so feel free to discuss them with us
